title: Higher-Dimensional Rotary Position Embedding
abstract: arXiv:2608.29715v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Transformers rely on position embedding mechanisms in long context modeling in most cases. Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) embeds positional information with independent 2D rotations, forming relative position terms in self-attention. However, its pairwise, block-based, and decoupled structure limits deep mixing and robustness across channels. We propose HD-RoPE, which extends RoPE from independent 2D rotations to higher-dimensional rotations and introduces a Paley-I orthogonal basis to obtain balanced, isotropic, and dense phase mixing within each rotation subspace. This significantly enhances channel coupling and rotational degrees of freedom while maintaining orthogonal stability and the relative position closure property. Furthermore, HD-RoPE is easily optimized for engineering efficiency without introducing additional trainable parameters. translated_abstract: 在大多数情况下，Transformer 在长上下文建模中依赖位置编码机制。旋转位置编码通过独立的二维旋转嵌入位置信息，并在自注意力中形成相对位置项。然而，其成对、分块和解耦的结构限制了深度混合能力以及跨通道的鲁棒性。我们提出 HD-RoPE，将 RoPE 从独立的二维旋转扩展到高维旋转，并引入 Paley-I 正交基，在每个旋转子空间内实现平衡、各向同性且密集的相位混合。这显著增强了通道耦合和旋转自由度，同时保持了正交稳定性和相对位置封闭性。此外，HD-RoPE 易于针对工程效率进行优化，且不引入额外的可训练参数。我们进行了广泛的评估，结果表明 HD-RoPE 取得了显著的提升。
tldr: HD-RoPE 将旋转位置编码从独立的二维旋转扩展为高维旋转，并借助 Paley-I 正交基实现平衡、各向同性的密集相位混合，在保持相对位置封闭性的同时显著增强通道耦合与旋转自由度，且无需额外可训练参数。
en_tdlr: HD-RoPE extends Rotary Position Embedding from independent 2D rotations to higher-dimensional rotations using a Paley-I orthogonal basis, achieving balanced, isotropic, and dense phase mixing that significantly enhances channel coupling and rotational degrees of freedom while preserving relative position closure and requiring no additional trainable parameters.
